title: China's research vessel near Batanes can locate subsea cables, Tarriela says
summary: The Philippine Coast Guard is still monitoring the activities of Chinese marine scientific vessel Jia Hai Ke that was seen loitering 37 nautical miles from the northwest of Itbayat, Zambales.
